title: Names used by batch p2-G02-1 (ASN context, IP context lists, IPinfo, Shodan API, Abusix abuse contacts)

attributes.peeringdb_network: PeeringDB record of the AS {asn, name, aka, operator, org_id, info_type, network_class, scope, traffic, ratio, prefixes4, prefixes6, policy {general, locations, ratio, contracts, url}, ix_count, ixps [capped {name, speed_mbps, is_rs_peer, ix_br}], fac_count, facilities [capped {name, city, country}], truncated, irr_as_set, website, looking_glass, updated, poc_roles}; contact objects are dropped at ingestion (PeeringDB AUP)
attributes.bgp_ranking: CIRCL BGP Ranking context of the AS {asn, description, position, total_known_asns, percentile, rank_score, date, text, explanation}: higher percentile = more malicious activity observed in the address space; large clouds and hosters always rank high; context only, never a verdict or a consensus vote
attributes.ipasn_history: origin ASN and prefix of the IP per date, latest first and capped [{date, asn, prefix, source}] (CIRCL IPASN History)
attributes.announced_prefixes: prefixes the AS announces (normalised, sorted, capped list; announced_prefix_counts holds the totals)
attributes.context_tags: context labels of an IP, domain or user agent from downloaded lists (vpn, datacenter, proxy, rmm_tool, dynamic_dns, suspicious_user_agent, privacy_relay): context only, never a malicious verdict; tags suppressed by privacy_relay are not listed
attributes.context_matches: list matches behind context_tags [{tag, list, matched, label, dataset, sha256, fetched_at, age_days, stale, suppressed_by}] with the provenance of each local dataset copy
attributes.privacy_relay: Apple iCloud Private Relay egress range of the IP {range, country, region, city, dataset}: ordinary Safari/iCloud+ users, never scored as an anonymiser; it suppresses VPN/proxy scoring for that range
attributes.as_domain: registrable domain of the organisation operating the AS that announces the IP (IPinfo as_domain): company context, not the user of the address
attributes.host_os: operating system reported for the host by an internet-scanner banner (e.g. Shodan 'os'): version-inferred, confirm on the host
attributes.scanner_search: seed-only internet-scanner search {query, total, returned, credits_spent, matches [{ip, port, hostnames, org, timestamp}]} (Shodan search): candidates, never verdicts
attributes.abuse_contact_non_role: addresses published as abuse contacts that do not look like role mailboxes: kept as context, never pivoted

tags.vpn: VPN endpoint or exit (anonymizer context for CR28): traffic from many users, never malicious on its own
tags.hosting: hosting/datacenter address (context for CR28 anonymized infrastructure), never malicious on its own
tags.rmm_tool: domain of a remote monitoring and management (RMM) tool (ip_context_lists): context only, legitimate admin software often abused for persistence
tags.suspicious_user_agent: user agent listed as belonging to an offensive tool, scanner or malware (ip_context_lists, exact match): context only, never a verdict

relations.operated_by: ASN -> organisation operating the network (PeeringDB organisation, self-declared): free-text name, homonym-prone, listed with expand=False
relations.asn_candidate: company name -> ASN whose PeeringDB network name contains it (name match only: POSSIBLE, homonym-prone, listed with expand=False)
relations.operator_domain: IP -> registrable domain of the organisation operating the announcing AS (IPinfo as_domain): company context, not the user of the address, listed with expand=False
relations.serves_certificate: IP -> SHA-256 fingerprint of a TLS certificate the host served on a port (internet-scanner banner)
relations.cert_subject: IP -> domain named in the subject CN of a TLS certificate the host served (internet-scanner banner)
relations.scanner_match: seed (favicon hash, certificate fingerprint, keyword) -> host an internet-scanner search matched (Shodan search): candidate, listed with expand=False
